title: Amazon Embedded Lending
description: Helped bring QuickBooks Lending to Amazon Marketplace sellers. I owned referral validation and the partner service that synchronized loan application status with Amazon.
details: Reused the existing application flow and Kafka infrastructure to launch the first phase on schedule.
Built logic that compared Intuit’s application snapshot with Amazon’s current status and sent missing transitions in order.
Used idempotent updates and retry handling so failed updates could be replayed without repeating completed steps.

title: TurboTax Flex Advance
description: Owned the payment configuration for a consumer lending product in TurboTax. I adapted an existing vendor integration to support interest-only repayments followed by a final balloon payment.
details: Worked with the payment vendor to define product-specific settings within the existing repayment workflow.
Built temporary test APIs and scenario-based test data to validate repayment flows while upstream dependencies were still being tested.
Fixed a product-specific repayment retry rule before production and used Karate regression tests to verify existing products retained their retry behavior.

title: Camunda Workflow Engine Upgrade
description: Contributed to a Camunda workflow engine upgrade that included migrating existing workflow data from MySQL to PostgreSQL.

title: Integration Test Authentication Migration
description: Migrated the Lending Platform’s integration tests from username-based authentication and authorization to bot-based access before the legacy API was retired.
details: Owned the migration and delivered it one week ahead of the retirement deadline.
Documented the new setup so other engineers could configure it independently.
